stem: Quadrilateral PRST is transformed according to the rule \((x, y) \to (x + 9, y + 4)\) to create quadrilateral \(P'R'S'T'\). Which statement is true?

options.label: A
options.text: The side lengths of quadrilateral \(P'R'S'T'\) are twice the corresponding side lengths of quadrilateral \(PRST\).

options.label: B
options.text: The angle measures of quadrilateral \(P'R'S'T'\) are equal to the corresponding angle measures of quadrilateral \(PRST\).

options.label: C
options.text: The side lengths of quadrilateral \(P'R'S'T'\) are 9 units longer than the corresponding side lengths of quadrilateral \(PRST\).

options.label: D
options.text: The angle measures of quadrilateral \(P'R'S'T'\) are greater than the corresponding angle measures of quadrilateral \(PRST\).

visual_elements: Graph with quadrilateral PRST plotted on coordinate plane with vertices at P(-5,4), R(-2,3), S(0,0), and T(-6,0).
